sources.review_notes: All 9 pages reviewed against page renders by one reviewer agent (report: reports/review-pages-0001-0009.md): two-column reading order and joins, 12 figures and 6 algorithm boxes checked by crops (merged Fig. 3/4 box split, body text separated from the Fig. 9 and Fig. 11 captions), equations (1)-(12) taken from the authors' TeX with macros expanded and compared with 200-250 dpi crops, references [1]-[37] regenerated from the .bbl and read against the page. Verifier diagnostics on pages 3-8 are LaTeX-notation differences, algorithm transcriptions and minus-sign glyphs, adjudicated per page.
